website.note: Pipeline confirmed via 10-K and ctgov; web page not fetched.

pipeline.modality: Oral insulin capsule using POD (Protein Oral Delivery) platform
pipeline.license_origin: Internal; clinical development to be conducted by OraTech (Oramed/HTIT JV — note JV agreement was terminated in October 2025; revised plan is for OraTech entity, with subsequent Share Purchase Transaction discussed in 10-K)

indications.indication: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with inadequate glycemic control on 1-3 oral glucose-lowering agents (high-responder subpopulation: BMI/HbA1c/age-defined)
indications.trial_design: Double-blinded, placebo-controlled, double-dummy multi-center randomized 60-patient US Phase 3 study to validate ORMD-0801 efficacy and safety in T2DM subjects on 1-3 glucose-lowering agents; designed as smallest adequately powered trial to validate the high-responder subpopulation identified post-hoc from ORA-D-013-1
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — NOT_YET_RECRUITING; protocol submitted to FDA Sep 12, 2024; trial initiation planned H2 2026 (to be conducted by OraTech)
key_milestones: Sep 12, 2024: Phase 3 protocol submitted to FDA

excluded_preclinical: Other POD oral protein-delivery applications (e.g., oral exenatide / GLP-1) — not in active clinical development per FY2025 10-K
excluded_legacy_terminated: ORA-D-013-1 Phase 3 T2DM (NCT04606576) — TERMINATED; missed primary and secondary endpoints (announced Jan 11, 2023)
ORMD-0801 Phase 3 (NCT04817215) sponsor King Hamad University Hospital — UNKNOWN status; not Oramed-sponsored
